name: architecture/layer-boundary
summary: A layer imports a layer outside its `may_depend_on` allowlist.

activation.description: architecture.layers defines layer dependencies.

name: architecture/cross-feature-import
summary: A feature imports another feature outside the allowed layer pairs.

activation.description: architecture.features defines feature boundaries.

name: architecture/forbidden-third-party-import
summary: A layer imports a third-party package its `third_party` policy does not allow.

activation.description: A layer's third_party policy restricts dependencies.

name: architecture/import-cycle
summary: Import cycles between architecture nodes or explicitly selected concrete modules.

name: architecture/shared-imports-feature
summary: A shared or central module imports a feature module.

activation.description: architecture.shared or a layer module binding declares shared/central modules.

name: architecture/composition-root-leak
summary: A module imports the composition root or a declared wiring module.

activation.description: architecture.composition_root or architecture.wiring declares assembly boundaries.

name: architecture/non-public-module-import
summary: Code outside a contracted package imports a private implementation module.

activation.description: A package API declares public entry points, including an explicitly empty public list.

name: architecture/missing-facade-export
summary: A public implementation name has many outside importers but no package export.

activation.description: A package API sets min_importers_to_export.

name: architecture/member-boundary
summary: A workspace member imports a member outside its may_depend_on allowlist.

activation.description: architecture.members declares workspace member boundaries.

name: architecture/undeclared-member-dependency
summary: A workspace member imports another member without declaring a direct project dependency.

activation.description: project.workspace is uv; static member metadata declares dependencies.

name: architecture/unknown-layer
summary: A feature contains a package or module outside the declared layers.

name: architecture/unclassified-module
summary: A module maps to no feature, layer, shared set or composition root.

name: architecture/uncovered-source
summary: Strict coverage found source outside the architecture policy or an exclusion without a reason.

name: architecture/missing-required-module
summary: A package is missing a required module or public entry point.

activation.description: A package API requires modules or named public entry points.

name: complexity/excess-attribute-depth
summary: Review a method call reached through multiple instance attributes.

activation.description: style or a package override sets navigation.

name: complexity/inline-call-argument
summary: An awaited result, eager comprehension or builtin reduction is passed directly as a call argument.

activation.description: style or a package override sets call_argument_kinds.

name: complexity/excess-positional-parameters
summary: A function accepts more positional parameters than its package allows.

name: complexity/duplicate-function
summary: A module-level function repeats another function's code.

name: complexity/forbidden-nested-conditional
summary: A conditional expression directly contains another result conditional.

name: complexity/excess-comprehension-loops
summary: A comprehension combines too many iteration or decision steps.

name: complexity/excess-constructor-decisions
summary: A constructor contains more decisions than the configured limit.

name: complexity/inline-constructor-receiver
summary: A method is called directly on a newly constructed instance.

name: frameworks/prefer-secret-type
summary: A secret-named settings field accepts an unwrapped str or bytes value.

name: frameworks/redundant-dishka-provider
summary: A Dishka provider method only forwards typed dependencies to a constructor.

name: idioms/bundled-instance-assignment
summary: An assignment writes multiple direct instance attributes under a separate-assignment convention.

name: idioms/prefer-match-type-dispatch
summary: Review a same-subject isinstance/elif chain for match/case under an explicit package policy.

activation.description: style or a package override sets type_dispatch.style to match.

name: idioms/prefer-callable-instance
summary: Review __call__ and an operation-based class name for a single public method.

name: idioms/redundant-name-alias
summary: A module-level name only repeats another class or function name.

name: idioms/missing-interface-docstring
summary: An abstract or Protocol method has a placeholder body and no docstring.

name: idioms/missing-broad-except-reason
summary: A broad exception handler does not say why it catches everything.

name: idioms/duplicate-narrowing-assert
summary: Several methods of a class assert the same narrowing of a self attribute.

name: idioms/loop-invariant-collection
summary: A membership lookup set is rebuilt in a loop from stable immutable inputs.

name: imports/excess-package-imports
summary: One caller spreads a package API across several import paths.

activation.description: A package API sets min_imports_to_bundle.

name: imports/excess-module-imports
summary: A module imports more project modules than its policy allows.

activation.description: style or a package override sets module_import_exemptions.

name: imports/forbidden-import-style
summary: An import does not follow the package's declared relative/absolute style.

activation.description: style or a package override sets imports.

name: imports/prefer-package-import
summary: Prefer an existing package re-export over an implementation import.

activation.description: style or a package override lists third_party_reexports.

name: layout/forbidden-module-name
summary: A package or module name is listed in style.forbidden_names.

activation.description: style.forbidden_names contains naming restrictions.

name: layout/module-docstring-convention
summary: A module docstring is missing or present against the package's module_docstrings convention.

activation.description: style or a package override sets module_docstrings to require or forbid.

name: layout/forbidden-private-module
summary: A module or package has an underscore prefix forbidden by its naming policy.

activation.description: style or a package override sets private_modules to forbid.

name: layout/definition-order
summary: Definitions are out of public-first order within modeled execution boundaries.

name: layout/misplaced-static-helper
summary: An internal static helper can be reviewed for extraction to a private module function.

name: layout/callee-before-caller
summary: A direct caller appears after same-visibility helpers it calls.

name: layout/file-name-convention
summary: A YAML or Compose filename differs from the project's canonical spelling.

activation.description: style.file_naming selects a canonical YAML extension or Compose basename.

name: layout/misplaced-private-constant
summary: A private literal constant is declared on an ordinary class instead of its module.

name: layout/redundant-module-name
summary: A module filename repeats context already supplied by an ancestor package.

name: layout/reexport-only-module
summary: An ordinary module consists entirely of explicit re-exports.

name: layout/misplaced-module-logger
summary: A module logger is declared outside the block immediately after imports.

name: layout/redundant-comment
summary: A comment or docstring only restates the name it documents.

name: layout/workspace-layout-convention
summary: A top-level package deviates from the uv workspace's folder layout.

activation.description: project.workspace is uv and project.workspace_layout selects flat or src.

name: meta/unused-suppression
summary: An inline suppression is unused or names an unknown identifier.

name: meta/missing-suppression-reason
summary: An inline suppression without a `-- reason`.

name: meta/resolved-debt
summary: A debt entry that no longer matches any violation.

name: meta/missing-rule-policy
summary: An explicitly enabled rule is missing the policy it needs in its scope.

name: meta/uncovered-package-facade
summary: A package facade cannot supply names that IMP004 is enabled to check.

name: meta/missing-tool-suppression-reason
summary: A noqa, type: ignore or other tool suppression without a reason.

name: modeling/redundant-str-enum-value
summary: Review .value on a known StrEnum member for direct use of the member.

name: modeling/forbidden-base-class-affix
summary: A class definition carries a Base prefix or suffix instead of a responsibility.

name: modeling/prefer-str-enum-discriminator
summary: Prefer StrEnum members for single-string class discriminator fields.

name: modeling/str-enum-value-convention
summary: A StrEnum spells its values against the configured auto/explicit convention.

activation.description: style or a package override sets str_enum_values.

name: modeling/dataclass-field-mutation
summary: A dataclass mutates its own fields after construction.

name: modeling/missing-dataclass-option
summary: A dataclass does not set an option its package requires.

activation.description: style or a package override sets dataclass_options, including [].

name: modeling/prefer-project-base-class
summary: A class inherits an outside base directly instead of the project base.

activation.description: style or a package override sets bases, including {}.

name: modeling/prefer-domain-exception
summary: Production code raises a builtin exception instead of the project hierarchy.

activation.description: style or a package override sets errors, including {}.

name: modeling/duplicate-class-name
summary: Two modules of one package define a public class with the same name.

name: modeling/implicit-duration-unit
summary: A numeric duration is named without its unit or written as an inline number.

name: modeling/mutable-field-in-frozen-dataclass
summary: A frozen dataclass directly declares a mutable collection field.

name: modeling/parallel-record-fields
summary: Stored sequence fields of one instance are paired by position.

name: tests/misplaced-test
summary: A test file does not live where tests.layout expects it.

activation.description: tests.layout is mirror.

name: tests/private-access
summary: A test imports or reads a private production name through a known module or instance.

name: tests/forbidden-mock
summary: A recognized mocking operation occurs in a test path that forbids mocks.

activation.description: tests.forbidden_mock_paths contains test path patterns.

name: tests/string-patch-target
summary: A recognized patch call or decorator uses a literal string target.

name: tests/excess-patches
summary: A collected test exceeds its configured number of recognized patch calls.

activation.description: The tests/excess-patches entry sets max, including zero.

name: tests/missing-outcome-check
summary: A collected test has no recognized explicit outcome assertion.

name: tests/vacuous-assertion
summary: Every recognized outcome can disappear or pass trivially on empty input.

name: tests/unbounded-wait
summary: A known test wait has no local deadline, or the scheduler clock is replaced.

name: tests/independent-case-loop
summary: A small literal loop repeats a candidate independent arrange/action/assert case.

name: tests/missing-await-assertion
summary: A known async mock is checked for calls without corresponding await evidence.

name: tests/nondeterministic-data
summary: A test module calls a known random or time-derived data generator, or reads the wall clock.

name: tests/missing-mirror-test
summary: A source module with behaviour has no test at its mirrored path.

name: tests/missing-skip-reason
summary: A test is skipped, expected to fail or rerun without a tracked reason.

name: typing/forbidden-future-annotations
summary: The annotations future import violates a package or Python-version policy.

activation.description: style or a package override sets future_annotations to forbid or when-needed.

name: typing/redundant-future-annotations
summary: Review an annotations future import with no detected postponement need.

activation.description: style or a package override sets future_annotations to when-needed.

name: typing/implicit-optional-default
summary: An optional parameter with a None default uses truthiness to choose a fallback.

name: typing/deprecated-async-contextmanager-return
summary: An @asynccontextmanager function annotates its return as AsyncIterator[T].

name: typing/duplicate-literal-type
summary: Review repeated multi-value Literal types for a shared type alias.

name: typing/prefer-deferred-annotations
summary: An annotation is quoted where deferred evaluation makes quotes unnecessary.

name: typing/anonymous-tuple-type
summary: A fixed-length tuple type leaves its fields unnamed.

name: typing/prefer-inline-type-parameters
summary: A generic class uses an explicit Generic[...] base on a Python 3.12+ target.

name: visibility/internal-public-member
summary: A public module function or instance method has no observed use outside its module or class.

name: visibility/internal-public-module-symbol
summary: A public module constant or type alias has no observed external use or public-signature evidence.

name: visibility/misplaced-dunder-all
summary: An ordinary module declares __all__ outside a package initializer.

name: visibility/internal-public-attribute
summary: A public instance or class data attribute has no observed access outside its visibility boundary.

activation.description: style or a package override sets public_attribute_boundary.

name: visibility/foreign-private-access
summary: Production code uses a private symbol or private attribute owned by another project module.

activation.description: style or a package override sets private_attribute_boundary.

name: visibility/redundant-private-delegate
summary: A method only forwards its parameters to a private method used nowhere else.

name: visibility/excess-private-definitions
summary: A module contains more private definitions than the configured limit.

name: visibility/reexport-convention
summary: A package initializer spells a re-export against its configured convention.

activation.description: style or a package override sets reexports to all or alias.

name: visibility/test-only-public-function
summary: A public module function is accessed from tests but has no observed production use outside its own module.

name: visibility/test-only-public-attribute
summary: Tests read a public attribute with no observed production access outside its visibility boundary.

name: visibility/deep-package-reexport
summary: A package initializer re-exports a name through a deeper import path.
